key_insights: S&P 500 implied move through next Friday (10/30) is 1.80%.
Next week is heavy on both macro and micro: a full slate of central bank decisions (FOMC and BOC Wednesday, ECB Thursday, BOJ Friday).
Next week is the heaviest week of Q3 earnings, with 44% of S&P market cap reporting. MSFT, GOOG, NOW and KLAC report Wednesday. AMZN and INTC report Thursday.
Brazil election results are due Sunday night. Polymarket gives Bolsonaro a 76% chance of winning, while local polls show him with a slimmer 0-2.5pt lead.
